scenario.configurationNote: Synthetic perturbation of the historical series; it does not describe future conditions.
scenario.notComputedHint: Uncomputed combinations require a job to run.
scenario.launchHelp: Combinations not computed yet run as a server job; nothing is calculated here.

scenario.chosenId: Scenario to compute: {{id}} (a synthetic perturbation of the historical series; it does not describe future conditions).

calendar.validationScope: Compares configurable rules with zonal historical weather. This is not a forecast or parcel-specific measurement.
calendar.plantingCriteriaPass: The date passes the configured rules
calendar.noPlantingAlerts: No alerts were found with the available data.
calendar.provisionalPlantingRules: Provisional pilot rules: configurable window and thresholds pending local validation with MAGA/ZARC.
calendar.heatmapEmpty: The heatmap is not available yet
calendar.selectFilters: Select a run and filters with computed results.
calendar.heatmapInsufficient: There are no evaluable years or dates to display.
calendar.heatmapTableDescription: Accessible heatmap by planting date and year
calendar.chartEmpty: The dekad chart requires a computed run and cycle.
calendar.baseComparison: BASE comparison requires an already computed BASE scenario.
calendar.baseSelected: BASE is selected; choose another computed combination for comparison.
calendar.comparisonNote: Both results are shown side by side; the frontend does not calculate differences.
calendar.exploratoryNote: The association is exploratory; it does not establish causality.
calendar.stageBandsPending: The contract does not yet define the visual fields for crop stages and cumulative values.
calendar.thresholdsPending: The threshold DTO does not define its display labels and values.
calendar.chartTableValues: See exact values, evidence and provenance in the accessible table.
calendar.dekadSelection: Cohort and planting date for the dekad chart
calendar.dekadChartDescription: Bars of effective precipitation and crop demand per dekad, with critical stages shaded and dekads over the threshold marked
calendar.historyChartDescription: Annual precipitation and ET0 over the 25 years
calendar.historyEmpty: The 25-year history is not yet available for this run.
calendar.noThresholds: This map does not list its thresholds. The engine uses sandbox thresholds without citation (see the dekad chart and the limits of this result); no figure here is a validated agronomic limit.

strategy.coverageNote: Share of days with no value in each year (missing values are never filled with zero). A ◐ marks a partial year: the source has not published every day yet. Each cell derives from the curated daily series of the zone; see the data-source table above for product and version.

flags.peff_sensible_al_metodo: Sensitive to the Pef method: compare the range between methods

strategy.catalogEmpty: There are no strategies in the catalog.
strategy.catalogEmptyDetail: Versioned strategies will appear here with their cycles once the catalog has them.
strategy.dateIsNotRotation: Changing the planting date or the variety is not a rotation: each strategy states which axis changes.

ranking.tradeoffPending: Contribution details await the R2/R3 response contract.
ranking.noRanking: No ranking has been computed for this combination.
ranking.identityPending: The ranking response has no recognized strategy identifier; scores are not attributed to a strategy.
ranking.weightSumError: The sum must equal 1 to update the ranking.
ranking.pending: Select a computed run and scenario to compare priorities.
ranking.top1Share: Share of weight samples where each strategy ranks first
ranking.tradeoffDescription: Bars per criterion for each strategy
ranking.marginWithinUncertainty: The gap between the top positions is within the uncertainty.
ranking.excludedReason: data are missing for some strategies (common support)
ranking.insufficientExplain: Weight coverage is below the minimum: the partial table is shown and no order is declared.
ranking.noExplanations: The engine returned no pairwise explanations.
ranking.inversionsNeedBoth: The BASE ranking and the chosen scenario ranking are both needed.
ranking.inversionsInsufficient: One of the rankings is insufficient; the order is not compared.
ranking.autoRebalance: When one weight moves, the others are rescaled proportionally so the sum stays 1.

soil.heading: Soil
soil.soilgrids_note: Spatial estimates from the SoilGrids model at 250 m (mean of the 0–5 cm layer, averaged over sample points inside the municipality). They are model estimates, not laboratory results, and do not describe any individual plot.
soil.soilgrids_demo: Plot-level soil (identifier, laboratory upload, declarations) needs a registered account. The public demo shows only the zonal estimates above.
soil.uploadPending: Row validation will connect when R3 confirms the multipart field and response.
soil.voiUnavailable: The analysis waits for a base result and a documented tolerance matrix.
soil.parcelIdHelp: The parcel list requires the R3 contract; exact geometries are not displayed.
soil.noParcel: Select a parcel to view its properties.
soil.alreadyMeasured: The property is already measured; the system does not calculate stability for it.
soil.labRecommended: The engine recommends obtaining a laboratory analysis.
soil.nothingAccepted: The file contributed no property with a value.
soil.emptyMeansUnknown: An empty cell means "not measured", never zero. Every property with a value needs its method.
soil.declareTitle: Declare a value with its basis
soil.declareHelp: A declared value is stored as "declared", not as measured.
soil.missingMatrix: The cited pH tolerance matrix is missing; without it this cannot be assessed.
soil.labNotRecommended: The engine does not recommend a lab test with the current information.
soil.topUnderHypothetical: Strategy ranked first under this hypothetical value

map.label: Map of Jocotán with the municipal boundary and climate data cells
map.help: Click inside the green outline of {{label}}, or type coordinates, to check a location. This is a visual aid only.
map.notSaved: The selection is shown on this page only. It is not saved and no parcel is created or registered; a stored location is always re-checked by the server and kept only as a coarse grid cell.

map.outside: That location is outside {{label}}. Pick a point inside the green outline.
map.cellInside: It falls inside the climate data cell used for the analysis.
map.cellOutside: It falls outside the climate data cell used for the analysis: the climate figures on this site describe the cell, not this exact place.
map.cellTooltip: {{source}} climate data cell: a context layer, not a parcel or the municipal boundary
map.tilesFailed: The base map tiles could not be loaded (no connection or the provider is blocked). The municipal boundary and climate cells are still drawn.
map.areaTooltip: Analysis zone: the approximate area the climate series is built for (context layer, not a parcel or the municipal boundary)

agronomy.legendTitle: How to read the data on this page
agronomy.provisionalNotice: Planting dates and agronomic thresholds are provisional references pending official validation for Jocotán by MAGA/ICTA.
agronomy.formTitle: Check a planting: crop, variety, cycle and date
agronomy.formScope: Compares your choice with the configured calendar and water thresholds. It does not forbid anything: you can always continue with the simulation.
agronomy.rain15: Rain over the last 15 days, mm (optional)
agronomy.waterHelp: If you leave these empty, the zone's historical series is used for that date (not a forecast). What you type has priority.
agronomy.windowBanner: The date is outside the configured planting window. This is a compatibility notice with the reference calendar, not a prohibition.
agronomy.droughtBanner: Drought signal: a configured water threshold was reached.
agronomy.dryThreshold: {{days}} consecutive days with rain below {{mm}} mm
agronomy.rainThreshold: At least {{mm}} mm of rain in the first 15 days
agronomy.noAlerts: No alerts with the information given.
agronomy.resultOk: The choice meets the configured provisional rules
agronomy.resultReview: Review these alerts (they are not a prohibition)
agronomy.kcNote: Kc values are FAO-56 proxies, not measured for ICTA varieties.
agronomy.optionsError: The agronomic configuration could not be loaded; the rest of the app keeps working.
agronomy.sandboxBanner: SANDBOX SIMULATION — NOT AN OPERATIONAL ALERT
agronomy.sandboxText: This estimated onset of the rainy season uses a configurable pentad-based rainfall method. It does not replace official INSIVUMEH bulletins and must not be used as the sole basis for planting decisions.
agronomy.notDetected: No onset detected with the configured criterion
agronomy.insufficientData: Insufficient data to evaluate the criterion
agronomy.criterionText: A pentad (5 days) with at least {{mm}} mm; one or both of the next two pentads also reach it; the previous and next pentads exceed {{cont}} mm.
agronomy.criterionSource: Criterion source: MAGA Report No. 6 (8 May 2025), using INSIVUMEH/ICC data, adapted from Alfaro, Cid & Enfield (1999). It is not an official INSIVUMEH method.
agronomy.delayDays: {{n}} days between the estimated onset and your planting date
agronomy.stationLevelC: EVIDENCE LEVEL C — LOCAL VALIDATION PENDING
agronomy.stationTextC: Satellite precipitation data have not yet been validated against the Camotán meteorological station. Historical station data are pending from INSIVUMEH.
agronomy.stationLevelB: EVIDENCE LEVEL B — VALIDATED LOCALLY (evaluated product and period only)
agronomy.uploadReady: Feature ready for future station data integration.
agronomy.uploadHow: The server reads a CSV with the columns fecha and precipitacion_mm placed by the operator; this page does not upload or process files.
agronomy.exampleFile: An example file with fictitious data was found: it is only a format test and does not change the status.
